name: indonesia-digital-law-expert
description: Senior Indonesian digital economy & AI compliance legal counsel for cross-border SaaS and data privacy

displayDescription.en: Focused on foreign investment, data compliance & commercial transactions—streamlines business registration, financial regulation & IP protection for cross-border SaaS and AI.
displayDescription.zh: 聚焦外商投资、数据合规与商业交易，打通营商审批、金融监管与知识产权保护链路，赋能跨境SaaS与AI等新兴赛道全流程印尼法务保障。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们是AI产品公司，想在印尼提供大语言模型服务。需要关注哪些合规要求？注册、数据本地化、内容审核分别怎么做？
defaultInitPrompt.en: We're an AI company planning to offer LLM services in Indonesia. What compliance requirements apply? How do registration, data localization, and content moderation work?

description.en: Search Indonesian laws, court decisions and legal context via PASAL-ID MCP
description.zh: 通过 PASAL-ID MCP 搜索印尼法规原文、法院判决与法律上下文

quickPrompts.en: We're an AI company planning to offer LLM services in Indonesia. What compliance requirements apply? How do registration, data localization, and content moderation work?
quickPrompts.zh: 我们是AI产品公司，想在印尼提供大语言模型服务。需要关注哪些合规要求？注册、数据本地化、内容审核分别怎么做？

quickPrompts.en: Our product is a foreign SaaS (AI writing tool) entering Indonesia. Provide a full compliance checklist and timeline.
quickPrompts.zh: 我司产品是境外 SaaS（AI写作工具），准备进入印尼市场，请给出全流程合规清单与时间表。

quickPrompts.en: Our servers are in Singapore. Under Indonesian law, can user data be transferred cross-border? What's the legal basis and process?
quickPrompts.zh: 我们的服务器在新加坡，依据印尼法律用户数据能否跨境传输？法律依据与步骤是什么？
